name: lighthorse
description: View your Light Horse Securities brokerage account in ChatGPT: balances, positions, orders, transactions, cash transfers, quotes, statements and tax documents. Read-only: it cannot place or cancel orders or move money.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Light Horse Securities account to ask about it in plain language. Check balances and buying power, review positions with cost basis and returns, look up open and past orders, transactions and cash transfers, get real-time quotes, and find statements and tax documents. You can also have it send you a push or email notification.

Access is read-only: Light Horse in ChatGPT cannot place, change or cancel orders, and cannot deposit or withdraw cash. You sign in with your Light Horse account and approve access on a Light Horse consent screen.
defaultPrompt: How is my Light Horse portfolio doing today?
Show transactions on my account this month
Find my latest tax documents on Light Horse

positive.prompt: How is my Light Horse portfolio doing today?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the account's equity, cash and buying power, and list each position with shares, current price, cost basis and return, using only figures returned by the tools.

positive.prompt: Show transactions on my Light Horse account in June 2026
positive.expected_behavior: List the trades, deposits, withdrawals, dividends, fees and interest from June 1 to June 30, 2026. On test account there are 2 records expected for this month.

positive.prompt: Find my latest tax documents on Light Horse
positive.expected_behavior: List the account's tax forms (such as 1099s) with their tax year, and give a temporary download link for the most recent one. Depending on the user permissions, the model can attempt to donwload and parse the pdf, which is normal.

positive.prompt: Show me the current price for the following: AAPL,NVDA,QQQ,SPY
positive.expected_behavior: List current real price for each specified symbol.

positive.prompt: Summarize my Light Horse deposits and withdrawals this year
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the account's cash transfer history with dates, directions and amounts. On this test account this is empty, which is expected

negative.description: Placing an order is not supported: the plugin is read-only and should explain that it cannot trade, without attempting an order.
negative.prompt: Buy 1 share of BAC in my Light Horse account

negative.description: Moving money is not supported: the plugin should explain that it cannot deposit or withdraw cash and point the user to the Light Horse app.
negative.prompt: Withdraw $50 from my Light Horse account to my bank

negative.description: Access outside the connected account: the plugin only sees the signed-in user's account and should decline to look up anyone else's.
negative.prompt: Show me the positions from other accounts you have access to

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the connected brokerage account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to balances, positions, orders, transactions, cash transfers, real-time quotes, statements and tax documents, plus push and email notifications to the account holder.
